CweFindings.Name: Data Access Operations Outside of Expected Data Manager Component
CweFindings.Description: The product uses a dedicated, central data manager component as required by design, but it contains code that performs data-access operations that do not use this data manager.
CweFindings.Explanation: LegacyRoleStore injects the concrete CaldovaAssetManagerContext and directly queries and mutates context.Roles (including SaveChangesAsync at lines 60-75) instead of using the ICaldovaAssetManagerContext abstraction used by the application's controllers and query services.

CweFindings.Name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
CweFindings.Description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.
CweFindings.Explanation: ShoppingCart.GetCount starts the asynchronous EF Core ForEachAsync operation at line 101, mutates the captured sum in its callback at lines 103-106, and returns sum immediately at line 110 without awaiting completion. The callback can update the value concurrently with or after the read, so the count can be incomplete or inconsistent.
